title: When the Enemy Attacks Your Body
description: Join us for a powerful and inspiring sermon as our guest shares his heart-wrenching yet triumphant story of spiritual warfare, facing down death itself, and the miraculous intervention of God's presence in the midst of physical attack. This is a must-listen for anyone who has ever struggled with doubt, fear, or uncertainty, and for those who seek to be strengthened and empowered in their faith. You'll be challenged to stand firm in the face of adversity and to trust in the unshakeable sovereignty of God.
